the following issues: (1) the signal scheduling problem for the FlexRay static communication segment is formulated as an ILP problem; (2) the proposed ILP problem is solved with the CPLEX solver; (3) a rectangle bin packing heuristic is proposed for solving the ILP problem; and (4) the proposed approach supports both the single sender slot and multiple sender slot scheduling mechanisms.
